scope: Public visible copy, metadata, generated HTML, llms.txt, and RSS. These controls record website boundaries; they do not provide legal approval.

hardBlocks.pattern: \b(?:no hidden fees?|no hidden anything|no surprise fees?|no surprises|no junk fees?)\b
hardBlocks.neutralBoundary: Applicable lender charges and third-party costs are disclosed in writing after review and in final transaction documents.

hardBlocks.label: unapproved unrestricted use-of-funds promise
hardBlocks.pattern: \b(?:Grand Funding doesn['’]t restrict use of funds|use the funds for anything|no restrictions? on (?:the )?use of funds|funds may be used for any purpose)\b
hardBlocks.neutralBoundary: Permitted uses of funds and exit requirements are determined after review of the specific transaction and disclosed in writing.

hardBlocks.neutralBoundary: Payment structure is determined after review of the specific transaction and disclosed in writing.
